profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary: Adventurous, empathetic, tenacious: those are the words that represent my strive to become the best software engineer that I can be. I have always been fascinated with the way technology is able to influence the world and the growth of it compared to many years ago. I hope that I can use my experience and skills to showcase my determination and hard work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I contributed to NetSuite Connector and the NetSuite Outlook Connector, developing large-scale integrations that reliably process millions of e-commerce transactions across Shopify, BigCommerce, Amazon, Walmart, Square, and other platforms.
- My work supported high-volume, bidirectional synchronization of orders, refunds, products, inventory, settlements, payouts, fulfillment updates, and other business-critical data between NetSuite, ecommerce storefronts, marketplaces, and 3PL systems.
- I helped build scalable and resilient workflows designed to handle significant transaction volumes while maintaining data accuracy and consistency across distributed systems. These integrations automate complex financial and operational processes, reduce manual work, and enable businesses to grow across multiple sales channels. I also contributed to the Outlook Connector, integrating NetSuite customer and business data with Microsoft Outlook.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designed and shipped customer-facing mortgage technology across React/Redux, AngularJS, C#, SQL, REST-integrated services, and AWS, translating product requirements into maintainable end-to-end solutions.
- Created a shared UI foundation and reusable front-end patterns, established CI/CD and UI deployment pipelines, and led development of a service-health dashboard used across Velocify engineering.
- Modernized outdated frameworks, improved product accessibility to more than 90%, and standardized delivery with Jenkins and Terraform while contributing technical decisions across multiple products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to both front-end (AngularJs, npm, webpack, less, mocha), back-end services (Java, Redis, maven, Junit, Mockito)
- Experienced with CI, CD using Jenkins. Experienced with AWS
- Maintained and Implemented features and unit tests using Java RESTful APIs 
- Dockerized the team's back-end services for local development. 
- Experienced in developing and integrating Amazon's Alexa skills
- Integrated services with internal and external APIs like Intuit Quickbooks, Yelp, Google Map, etc.
- Experienced in supporting translation and localization for multiple countries.
- Implemented software performance tracking with New Relic, and data analytics with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
- Created thorough documentations for projects / tasks I worked on.
- Applied agile development, scrummed daily, worked closely with the product team to speed the development process and resolve production issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Part-time Intern)
positions.description:
Developed content management systems for Macincloud clients management
website.
• Designed, improved and created client-website features by using PHP, MySQL database for the
back-end; HTML5, JS, and JQuery library for the front-end; utilizing CodeIgniter framework.
• Managed and maintained code-base using Git.
• Tested, documented bugs, new functionalities, features, and production versions.
• Integrated web features with third party APIs.

Website URL: https://app.macincloud.com

positions.title: Software Engineer (Part-time Intern)
positions.description:
With a team of 7 students, we built a free, IRS-sponsored tax preparation service available to qualifying taxpayers.
•	Led the back-end team of 4 interns to continuously deliver features on time.
•	Designed and developed an user-friendly and interactive web application using PHP, Javascript, Ajax, jQuery and Bootstraps.
•	Designed the SQL database, integrated multiple services into a single web application for different types of users (managers, volunteers, taxpayers)

projects.title: Smarter Tab - Google Chrome Extension
projects.description:
One day your laptop is frozen because your Chrome browser is using too much memory. You realize that you have TOO MANY UNUSED / INACTIVE open tabs which you don’t even remember why you did not close them.

Smarter Tab is the solution! Smart Tab’s main features:
1. Close inactive tab automatically to release your computer’s memory, reduce battery usage
2. History page will show all the tabs which have been closed automatically (allows searching, sorting with pagination)
3. Sort all tabs by URL, so that same-website tabs will be next to each other on Chrome --> makes it easier to find the tab you're looking for
4. User can set :
   Number of tabs which they want to keep (Smart Tab will not close any of the inactive tabs)
   Number of minutes for an inactive tab to be closed

projects.description:

Built the project with AngularJs, NodeJs which uses IBM Watson to train and query answers for super heroes related questions.
The application is currently working only on mobile web
